title: Cut lead output spent writing handoff, retro and PR bodies, and repeated skill loads
body:
Outcome: handoff, retro and PR body text is assembled by krn commands from short fields, and repeated krn-lead/krn-handoff/krn-retro Skill loads per session fall.
Why: lead-cost scan 2026-11-09: heredoc/Write/Edit output ~0.55M tokens (~$14 + cache re-reads, ~$0.15/PR); 252 Skill calls (krn-lead 93, krn-handoff 92, krn-retro 70) cost $14.8, $9.85 of it cache writes (~$0.1/PR).
Proof: scan of lead heredoc/Write bytes and Skill calls per PR before and after.
Scope: src/cli, .agents/skills.
